name: Concrete Structures Laboratory
description: Testing of constituent materials of concrete – cement, aggregates; concrete mix design; fresh concrete tests – slump test, compaction factor test, Vee-bee test; hardened concrete tests – compression, flexure, direct tension, reinforcement testing – tension, bending, bond; element testing, under reinforced beam, over reinforced beam, beam w/o shear reinforcement, beam for torsion, slab subjected to concentrated load, column subjected to eccentric and concentric load; non-destructive testing– rebound hammer, ultrasonic pulse velocity.
